line: Crowley on Chokmah (The Book of Thoth); Jung on Hokhmah in CW12 ¶313.

sections.title: Crowley's number 2
sections.line: Crowley on Chokmah as the number 2 and the first manifestation: The Book of Thoth, pdf p35, p175 and p211.

quotes.quote: Chokmah is really No. I and not No.2, because he is the first manifestation;
Magical manifestation of Chokmah, Wisdom, the Logos.

sections.title: Wisdom, the Father and Mercury
sections.line: Crowley on Chokmah as Wisdom, the Father and Mercury: The Book of Thoth, pdf p79 and p121.

quotes.quote: Father, who is Wisdom; he is the highest form of Mercury
Mercury as Chokmah “through whom alone we can approach Kether.”

sections.title: The path to Binah
sections.line: Crowley on Daleth as the path from Chokmah to Binah: The Book of Thoth, pdf p64.

quotes.quote: On the Tree of Life, Daleth is the path leading from Chokmah to Binah, uniting the Father with the Mother.

sections.title: The sphere of the fixed stars
sections.line: Crowley's list of the Universe, its second item: The Book of Thoth, pdf p111.

quotes.quote: The sphere of the Zodiac or fixed stars, represented by Neptune.

sections.title: Hokhmah in Franck's trinity
sections.line: Jung on Franck's connection between 32 and the cabalistic trinity Kether, Binah and Hokhmah: CW12 ¶313.

quotes.quote: Franck establishes a connection between 32 and the cabalistic trinity, Kether, Binah, and Hokhmah
